title: Filton6
summary: The initial six defendants, subsequent proceedings and the wider Filton cases, with the source dossier’s reporting kept together.
review_note: “Filton6” is the entry point for this research. The original dossier also covers the broader Filton 24/25 proceedings; counts, verdicts and sentences must be tied to the particular defendants and trial.

corrections.text: The original annotation suggested that section 1 only refers to the UK government or an intergovernmental body. Section 1(4)(d) also includes the government of a country other than the United Kingdom. That annotation has been corrected; this does not determine whether the other statutory conditions were met in any particular case.

body_html:
Twenty-five people charged over an August 2024 action at Elbit Systems’ Filton site near Bristol, approximately £1.2m damage, split across multiple trials. Six acquitted of aggravated burglary in February 2026 with a hung jury on criminal damage; four convicted at retrial in May 2026; sentenced 12 June 2026 by Justice Jeremy Johnson with a “terrorist connection” finding — the first ever applied to protest criminal damage in the UK. Three further trials run into 2027.
